items: Replying quickly and consistently to reviews, especially negative ones, helps you win back unhappy guests, build trust with future readers and signal to Google that each location is actively managed.
Every ignored or late reply can cost you a returning customer, their circle of friends and useful operational feedback, and across many locations that silent churn adds up.
Personalized replies that address the actual complaint, use the guest's name and match your brand voice work far better than copy-paste templates that guests spot instantly.
To scale, centralize reviews from every platform in one place, let AI handle routine and first replies, escalate high-risk reviews to people, and train the AI on your tone.
Track time to first response, how often guests update their review after your reply, recurring complaint keywords and escalation volume to see whether your process is improving the experience.
